title: fiber-algebra
description: FiberAlgebra (settlement fiber): the charged assignments over a single predicate's E × E square. Each assignment is a meme — a cell with its measured charge. The per-predicate component of the settled valuation; settle iterates these to their knowledge-least fixed point.

entities.description: The entities E indexing this fiber's E × E domain.

entity-set.description: The entity set E for this predicate's fiber.

assignments.description: The memes (cell + charge) assigned in this fiber — one per (subject, predicate, object) triple.

predicate.description: The predicate this fiber-algebra is the stalk over.
